name: Your Spouse
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacredness and permanence of the marital relationship, commanding faithfulness and forbidding adultery as seen in Exodus 20:14. A spouse is portrayed as a blessing and a gift from the Lord, with Proverbs 18:22 highlighting the favor found in a godly marriage. The Lord's hatred for divorce is clearly stated in Malachi 2:16 and affirmed in Mark 10:2, underscoring the call to uphold covenant faithfulness. Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ's love for the church, as taught in Ephesians 5:25.
